method.name: Estimated game learning levels from subtitle commonness and source-sense complexity
method.basicSenseSelection: For the small authored starter set, prefer only an already present CSV sense matching both the basic-meaning guard and an allowed explicit source POS; audit every changed selection. Otherwise retain source meaning and apply a non-basic-sense floor where needed.
method.limitation: Heuristic ordering, not CEFR, a validated learning assessment, or a semantic review of every CSV definition. Frequency refers to the English token; explicit source labels and basic-sense guards adjust sense-level difficulty.

penalties.length: 10–13 letters adds 1 only when frequency base >=3; 14–18 adds 2. Common top-1500 tokens receive no length penalty.

frequencySource.name: FrequencyWords English 2018 top 50,000
frequencySource.author: Hermit Dave / FrequencyWords contributors
frequencySource.changes: Source frequency file retained byte-for-byte. English ranks inform separate estimated game learning levels; no frequency text supplies or replaces Vietnamese translations.
frequencySource.limitations: Subtitle lemma/token frequency is not a CEFR assessment and does not directly measure familiarity of a particular Vietnamese sense. Missing words are outside this top-50k list, not known to have zero use. The user-provided CSV has its own unchanged provenance and unspecified license.
